transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because my fear of seeing a rat has gotten really bad. I work cleaning buildings, and it’s to the point where I can’t do some parts of my job anymore, especially trash rooms or old areas. I know in my head it’s probably not actually dangerous, but I just can’t handle the thought of one being there.
Is your fear mainly only when you might see a rat?

Yes, mainly that. It’s the thought that I might see a rat, like in a trash room or an old part of a building. Even if I know it’s probably not really dangerous, I just can’t make myself go in there sometimes.
